description: Rosetta scoring function used by ATOM3D as the state-of-the-art RSR comparison. The specific score function and settings are not stated.
source_locator: ATOM3D arXiv:2012.04035v4 Table 6, p.8 ([Watkins et al., 2020]); App. F.8, p.25; Table 7, p.27 and Table 8 RSR rows, p.28 ([Alford et al., 2017]).
basis: App. F.8 states that ATOM3D compares its RSR results 'against the Rosetta scoring function [Alford et al., 2017]', and Tables 7 and 8 give the same values under [Alford et al., 2017]. Table 6 instead cites [Watkins et al., 2020] (FARFAR2). Both citations are Rosetta-based, so the generic identity is supported; the specific scoring function is not.

known_details.label: Comparison
known_details.value: ATOM3D describes the Rosetta scoring function as a physical- and knowledge-based potential tuned for biomolecular structure, which has most consistently produced the lowest-RMSD candidates in past RNA Puzzles.

unknown.label: Citation conflict

unknown.label: Score function and settings
unknown.note: The specific Rosetta score function, weights and software version behind the values are not stated. FARFAR2 is not inferred as the ranking method.
